changed_surfaces.purpose: Delegate all dm_script persistence to ProgramRepository while retaining service-owned authorization, attachment lifecycle, transactions and audit orchestration.
Declare the complete dm_script MyBatis persistence contract.
Provide typed persistence boundary and not-found semantics.
Own parameter-bound program, attachment, component, recycle-bin and audit SQL.
Inject the service through an explicit ProgramMapper test double.

local_checks.check: Production direct-SQL scan and XML parse
local_checks.evidence: ProgramService has no direct JDBC/SQL references and ProgramMapper.xml parsed.

diff_summary: Migrated one dm_script service persistence boundary; no schema, route, DTO or Flyway change.

invariants_checked.invariant: Authorization, attachment, transaction and audit behavior remains service-owned
invariants_checked.evidence: Focused service tests cover validation, owner checks, attachments, recycle-bin administration and audit signals.

disturbances.impact: MySQL/Testcontainers regression is deferred to Docker-enabled CI/local environment.
